title: Actress Daveigh Chase Dies at 35
content: Chase voiced Chihiro in Studio Ghibli 's Spirited Away anime film in 2001 and Lilo in Disney's Lilo and Stitch film in 2002. She continued to voice Lilo in various films, television series, and games. She played Samara Morgan in the American live-action film The Ring .
